summary: Verified async /api/analyze + polling fix end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (fast submit returns {id,status:'processing'} in <10s, heavy.mp4 completes in ~55-120s via polling with stage transitions, two-file upload yields 2-row summary, demo stays synchronous and returns full job with sensitivity(6), download 409 guard fires while processing, zip has 5 files incl threshold_sensitivity.csv, delete works). Frontend: upload polling flow auto-renders KPIs/charts/tables/downloads without manual refresh. Demo button, Sensitivity tab+chart, Summary filter (now filters Summary rows 1→0), download links all point to /api/jobs/{id}/download?kind=..., history items visible, deep-link ?job={id} auto-loads done job.

issues: Benign Recharts warning on initial render: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container measures before layout settles; charts render correctly afterwards. Consider ResponsiveContainer with explicit minHeight or defer render until container measured.

critical_code_review_comments: Background task uses asyncio.create_task without a job queue — if the single-worker process restarts mid-job, status stays 'processing' forever. Consider a janitor that marks orphaned processing jobs as error on startup.
process_job calls shutil.rmtree in finally — fine, but no size/quota check on /tmp/nk_jobs upload dir; a very large upload could exhaust ephemeral storage.

Download endpoint only guards 'done' with 409, but 'error' status currently also returns 409 ('Analysis not finished yet'). Consider distinct 410/400 for error jobs with the stored error message surfaced.
seed_data_creation: Several test jobs created via tests; cleanup fixture deletes them. Demo jobs persisted (kept intentionally by test_demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async analyze flow verified. Hidden file input requires page.set_input_files('[data-testid=file-input]', ...) (do not wait_for visibility). Recent runs use data-testid='history-item-{id}' (not recent-job-*). Sensitivity tab/chart only render when job.sensitivity is non-empty. Heavy job polling can take 90-180s; use interval ~3s, timeout 240s.
